title: Flood repair can be costly
text: The Environment Agency cites £30,000 to repair a three-bedroom semi-detached house in 2014. This is a historical example, not a current quote.
label: Source fact · historical 2014 example

title: Repair time is a chance to adapt
text: Participating insurers may fund flood-resilience measures through Build Back Better after a flood claim, in addition to repairs. Insurer limits and eligibility apply.
label: Source fact · check current terms

title: Support can make a start easier
text: Eligible Halifax mortgage customers may receive £2,000 for a qualifying heat pump, £1,000 for solar or a battery, or £500 for other qualifying improvements. Check current terms.
label: Public offer · check current terms
